title: How can salt leakage from a salt-bath furnace be detected?
summary: Suneng's 2020 salt-bath heating proposal for steel parts provides a leak-prevention sealing groove at the furnace top plate and salt-leak detection electrodes in a collection trough at the furnace bottom. Confirm sealing, collection and detection locations separately. A salt-leak alarm does not mean the crucible cannot leak or that all subsequent response actions are defined.
